mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional Local SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both aim for local visibility, traditional Local SEO primarily focuses on optimizing existing website content, Google My Business profiles, and local citations. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) takes this a step further by using AI to proactively generate new, highly specific content based on emerging search trends and local user queries. GEO allows for more dynamic adaptation to local search intent, often producing content that directly answers frequently asked questions or addresses niche local interests, leading to more direct and relevant local search placements.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO uses AI to generate new, specific content for local searches, while traditional Local SEO optimizes existing assets. GEO offers more dynamic adaptation to local search intent.
